verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say that enabling Devin Review with Auto-Fix makes Devin automatically iterate on CI failures, so automated CI-failure remediation is a first-party capability. The evidence is a single thin mention tied to code review. It does not show Devin picking up an arbitrary failed CI workflow, diagnosing the root cause, and opening a new proposed pull request on its own. missing for 10: documented trigger on failed CI workflows outside Devin's own PRs, explicit diagnosis output, auto-created fix PR from a CI failure, setup/config depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have failed CI workflows automatically diagnosed and fixed with a proposed pull request

citations.quote: Enable Devin Review with Auto-Fix so Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
